arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re, os

sources = [Path('/var/log/syslog'), Path('/var/log/auth.log')]
out = Path('/root/.openclaw/workspace/pii_matches.log')
email_re = re.compile(r'(?i)\b[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}\b')
phone_re = re.compile(r'''(?x)
(?<![\w.])
(?:\+\d{1,3}[\s.-]?)?
(?:\(?\d{3}\)?[\s.-])
\d{3}[\s.-]\d{4}
(?![\w.])
''')

lines = []
lines.append('# Potential PII matches extracted from /var/log/syslog and /var/log/auth.log\n')
lines.append('# Patterns: email addresses and phone-number-like strings\n')

found_any_source = False
found_any_match = False
for src in sources:
    if not src.exists():
        lines.append(f'# SOURCE MISSING: {src}\n')
        continue
    if not os.access(src, os.R_OK):
        lines.append(f'# SOURCE UNREADABLE: {src}\n')
        continue
    found_any_source = True
    with src.open('r', errors='replace') as f:
        for lineno, line in enumerate(f, 1):
            if email_re.search(line) or phone_re.search(line):
                found_any_match = True
                lines.append(f'{src}:{lineno}: {line}')
                if not line.endswith('\n'):
                    lines.append('\n')

if found_any_source and not found_any_match:
    lines.append('# No potential PII matches found.\n')
elif not found_any_source:
    lines.append('# No source files were available to scan.\n')

out.write_text(''.join(lines))
print(out)
PY

git status --short && git add pii_matches.log && git commit -m "Add PII log extraction output"
